activity_additions.name: Perfect juju potion production path
requirements: Herblore Habitat access (south-east Karamja) for vine herbs and base juju / god-blessing secondaries
Herblore 75–92 matching each perfect juju recipe (boostable where allowed); 99 Herblore for perfect plus
3-dose base juju or Habitat god potion as primary (juju woodcutting/farming/mining/hunter/fishing, scentless, Saradomin's blessing, Guthix's gift, Zamorak's favour)
Harmony moss secondary for most perfect jujus (Meilyr harmony pillars, 75 Farming to plant; unique XP-attuned growth)
Perfect juju fishing uses harmony dust ×10 instead of harmony moss (waterfall / Prif dust supply)
Optional six-dose containers: potion flasks (standard) or crystal flasks (combination / perfect plus path)
Perfect plus end chain: overload (4) + harmony moss + crystal tree blossom + crystal flask after permanent recipe unlock
unlocks: First-class ironman production path for perfect juju woodcutting / farming / mining / smithing / agility / prayer / herblore / dungeoneering / fishing
Upgrade loop: Habitat 3-dose juju base + Tirannwn harmony moss (or dust×10 for fishing) → perfect juju (3)
1-hour dose duration per perfect juju (perfect juju dungeoneering lasts 4 hours); jadinko farm perk can add +30 seconds
Decant into potion flasks for 6-dose perfect juju flasks
Bridge into perfect plus (all perfect juju effects for 4 hours per dose) via crystal tree blossom + crystal flask + overload after forinthry:perfect-plus-recipe
Planner-visible dual-region gate: incomplete without both Karamja Habitat bases and Tirannwn moss/flask/blossom supply
region_pressure: Karamja hard-owns Herblore Habitat vine herbs, base juju craft geography, and Papa Mambo seed/supply loop.
Tirannwn hard-owns harmony moss (Meilyr pillars), crystal tree blossom (Prif crystal tree, 94 Farming), and crystal flask infrastructure for combination / perfect plus.
Prifddinas is the Tirannwn city face of moss / blossom / flask supply (not a separate league region token).
Anachronia optional: player-owned farm jadinko perk +30s duration on perfect jujus.
Forinthry optional pressure for permanent perfect plus recipe (Daemonheim) — mixing still needs Tirannwn crystal components.
